en.title: Events & Calendar
en.summary: Curated trade fairs, expos, summits, and corridor briefings designed for practical cross-border deal flow.
en.imageAlt: Conference audience watching a speaker on stage.
en.metaDescription: Explore LATAM China Tech events, trade fairs, expos, and summits connecting Latin America and China.
en.bodyHtml:
Our events are built for companies that need more than visibility. Every format is designed around qualified meetings, sector context, and follow-through after the room clears.

Trade fairs and expos connect operators with buyers, distributors, governments, and investors who are active in the China-LATAM corridor.

sections.title: Trade fairs and expos
sections.bodyHtml: Join curated exhibition programs where companies present products, schedule bilateral meetings, and receive market briefings before and after the event.

sections.title: Tech conferences and summits
sections.bodyHtml: We convene founders, corporates, cities, investors, and operators for tactical sessions on market entry, industrial partnerships, AI, climate, healthcare, and logistics.

sections.title: Upcoming corridor calendar
sections.bodyHtml: The first public calendar will combine LATAM China Tech hosted programs with selected partner events. Until then, teams can request a private shortlist based on sector and market goals.

br.title: Eventos e calendario
br.summary: Feiras, exposicoes, summits e briefings do corredor desenhados para gerar conexoes cross-border praticas.
br.imageAlt: Publico de conferencia assistindo a uma apresentacao no palco.
br.metaTitle: Eventos e calendario | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Explore eventos, feiras, exposicoes e summits da LATAM China Tech conectando America Latina e China.
br.bodyHtml:
Nossos eventos sao construidos para empresas que precisam de mais do que visibilidade. Cada formato prioriza reunioes qualificadas, contexto setorial e follow-up depois do encontro.

Feiras e exposicoes conectam operadores com compradores, distribuidores, governos e investidores ativos no corredor China-LATAM.

sections.title: Feiras e exposicoes
sections.bodyHtml: Participe de programas curatoriais onde empresas apresentam produtos, agendam reunioes bilaterais e recebem briefings de mercado antes e depois do evento.

sections.title: Conferencias e summits de tecnologia
sections.bodyHtml: Reunimos founders, corporates, cidades, investidores e operadores para sessoes praticas sobre entrada em mercado, parcerias industriais, AI, clima, saude e logistica.

sections.title: Calendario do corredor
sections.bodyHtml: O primeiro calendario publico combinara programas da LATAM China Tech com eventos selecionados de parceiros. Ate la, os times podem pedir uma shortlist privada por setor e mercado.

cn.title: 活动与日历
cn.summary: 面向真实跨境合作的展会、博览会、峰会和走廊简报。
cn.imageAlt: 会议观众正在观看舞台演讲。
cn.metaTitle: 活动与日历 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 探索 LATAM China Tech 连接拉美与中国的活动、展会、博览会和峰会。
cn.bodyHtml:
我们的活动不仅追求曝光，而是围绕高质量会议、行业语境和会后跟进设计。

展会与博览会把企业与活跃在中国-拉美走廊的买家、分销商、政府和投资人连接起来。

sections.title: 展会与博览会
sections.bodyHtml: 加入经过策划的展览项目，展示产品、安排双边会议，并在活动前后获得市场简报。

sections.title: 技术会议与峰会
sections.bodyHtml: 我们召集创始人、企业、城市、投资人和运营者，围绕市场进入、产业合作、AI、气候、医疗和物流开展务实讨论。

sections.title: 走廊活动日历
sections.bodyHtml: 首个公开日历将整合 LATAM China Tech 主办项目和精选合作伙伴活动。在此之前，团队可以按行业和市场目标申请私密活动清单。
